name: How much does it cost to build a home gym addition?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a home gym addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a home gym addition varies significantly based on its size, complexity, materials, and equipment. A basic conversion might start from a few thousand dollars, while a custom-built extension with high-end finishes and specialized electrical can exceed tens of thousands. Preparing a detailed list of your desired features and discussing it with a contractor will help define the scope and associated costs. A practical tradeoff to consider is the upfront investment versus long-term gym membership savings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on size, complexity, and materials, ranging from a few thousand for basic conversions to tens of thousands for custom builds.
